pro.rationale: The inventory contains no distinct debate-wide burden consequence beyond Peterson's scored motion, central, and subsidiary moves and their recorded replies.

eligibility.completionCriterion: No additional criterion applies beyond the burden contact and responsiveness already represented at move level.
